summary: Frontend-only UI verification of two CSS fixes on Polish SmartClout site: AboutV2Section (#about-v2) 'Trzy filary. Jeden proces.' and SwitchSection (#markets-switch) 'Sześć portów. Sześć rynków, które łączymy.'. All acceptance criteria met. Homepage loads without any console errors or warnings on preview URL.

AboutV2Section.desktop_1920: Renders as compact 2-column layout. Left column shows 3 stage cards (Uważność / Holistyczne spojrzenie / Optymalizacja) with proper Discovery/Architektura/TCO tags. Right column shows info panel with 62% progress chart. Section height ~950px — fits within a reasonable viewport. No horizontal overflow.
AboutV2Section.mobile_375: Stacks into a single column (width=375, height=1353). Timeline arrows between cards display cleanly, no overlap, no horizontal scroll.

SwitchSection.desktop_1920: Chassis centered and clearly narrower than section width. All 6 ports rendered with correct data-testids (switch-port-finance, -services, -industry, -telecom, -media, -gov). Staggered labels FINANSE, USŁUGI, PRZEMYSŁ, TELEKOMUNIKACJA I ŁĄCZNOŚĆ, MEDIA I ROZRYWKA, ADMINISTRACJA PAŃSTWOWA I UE visible. Partners carousel appears immediately below without excessive dead space (section height ~747px).
SwitchSection.port_hover: All 6 port hover actions executed without errors (elements are interactive).
SwitchSection.mobile_375: Section stacks properly (h=837px). No horizontal overflow.

verification_details.overflow_check: scrollWidth == clientWidth at 1920, 1280, 768, 375 — zero horizontal overflow at any tested viewport.
verification_details.navbar_mega_menu: Hover on 'Oferta IT' reveals mega-menu element in DOM.
verification_details.sections_present: #values, #about-v2, #markets-switch, #contact all found. Note: no elements with literal id='hero' or id='portfolio' — sections exist but under different ids/testids (not in fix scope, informational only).

critical_code_review_comments: Informational: Section anchors #hero and #portfolio mentioned in review request are not present as literal HTML ids on the page. Not a regression from the CSS fixes but main agent may want to align anchor ids with any nav links that expect them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both CSS compact overrides (AboutV2 lines 10702+ and SwitchSection lines 10837+ in App.css) are working as intended on the preview URL. No console errors, no horizontal overflow at any viewport, all 6 switch ports render with expected data-testids, layouts are compact and responsive. Screenshots captured at /app/.screenshots/about_desktop.png, switch_desktop.png, about_mobile.png, switch_mobile.png.
